layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one ship on the adventure map, a chunky round toy-like boat seen from the side with the camera slightly above it, so we see its hull's side and a little of its deck. Thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail. It floats on sea water that is not drawn: the hull's bottom is cut flat at the waterline and is the lowest thing in the image; all around it is the empty transparent background.

Subject: a plump little sloop like a bath toy, its bow pointing to the right: a short round fat hull of warm brown planks #9a6232 with #6a3f1e shadows and a cream rail stripe #efe3c2, a round porthole, one stout mast with one big fat billowing sail of plain white #f6f4ee with pale grey #cfcbc2 shadow, a small plain white triangular pennant at the masthead, a tiny chibi captain in a blue coat #2f5f9f and a brown hat at a round ship's wheel on the back deck. About four fifths of the image wide, the sail reaching near the top.
